pay_detail: Cost is listed for each camp. Lunch and snacks are included. A limited number of scholarships are available.
duration: Camps run 9 am to 3 pm; length varies by camp
name: Career Discovery Youth Camps at Madison College
org: Madison College, Professional and Continuing Education
what_you_do: Day camps from 9 am to 3 pm on trades, health, engineering, culinary and arts topics, with field trips. Students try hands-on career skills at the college.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 3 to 12. Each camp lists its own grades, based on grade level in fall 2026.
deadline_text: Summer 2027 camp registration opens February 28, 2027 at 8:00 AM. Camps are posted in January.
how_to_apply: Add the camp to the cart on the registration site and enter the student information. Look for the scholarship form on the page.
notes: Camps on this page are at the Madison campuses. The college also lists camps at Fort Atkinson, Portage, Reedsburg and Watertown on a separate regional page.
